Swimming is an inherent ability of all player characters, and some mobs, which allows one to travel in and under water. Swimming is slower than running, but faster than walking. When your character is in the water, press the sit key will dive deeper, while pressing the jump key will surface. You can hold the left mouse button to look around. You can hold the right mouse button and then move your mouse up and down to change your swim direction. Moving your character forward or backwards will then make them swim in the direction you have chosen. One of the Draenei priests' racial abilities, Symbol of Hope was an instant cast spell with a 5 minute cooldown. It gave all party members 33 mana every 5 seconds for 15 seconds at level 10 and the mana regained every 5 seconds increases with level up to 333 mana every 5 seconds at level 70. It follows this formula: mp5 = 5 * (level - 10) + 33

Tabetha is a human quest giver located at Tabetha's Farm deep in the Quagmire in Dustwallow Marsh. She is a powerful mage living with two apprentices. A road leads to her shack, which can be found north of Stonemaul Ruins. She and Menara Voidrender have a history together. She has been training generations of apprentices at her farm, from both the Alliance and the Horde, though this shouldn't be possible as the humans only arrived in Kalimdor within the last decade. As she is seen working with vials, she is apparently an alchemist.

Strong demons — the heroes of their kind — can corrupt individuals, tribes, or even whole species. The victims must drink of the demon’s blood. This act begins a transformation, taking anywhere from years to generations to millennia, that converts the creatures and their descendants into demons. Those who have begun but not completed this process are tainted creatures. Tainted creatures typically serve the Burning Legion in one fashion or another. Tribes, nations, and species that accept a demon's pact become tools. A talent calculator is a device allowing a person to experiment with talent points and specialization allotments. Blizzard has added a limited in-game talent calculator ability that can be activated through the preferences (under "Display" -> "Preview Talent Changes"). This allows free manipulation of any unallocated talent points, but not de-allocation of talent points that had previously been allocated and saved.

During the invasion of Gilneas, Darius Crowley and other Gilnean worgen were here, along with the night elves Talran of the Wild, Vassandra Stormclaw, and Lyros Swiftwind. Talents have gone through some very substantial changes over the years. The prime form of character augmentation and customisation in World of Warcraft, talents were the predecessors of specializations, predating the introduction of fixed specializations by many years. Originally a complex and intricate system of possible combinations, since Wrath of the Lich King talents have been reduced and simplified, with many of their earlier functions being split off into other mechanisms. Killing Talaporas grants 100 points of standing with Ve'nari, is worth roughly 75 Stygia, and adds 500 points of threat (50% of a level) to the Eye of the Jailer. Additionally, Talaporas drops the Borogove Cloak and Dominion Etching: Pain. Tamaala was the lifemate of Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof and the mother of Baine Bloodhoof. She died some time before the events of the Third War and, according to Cairne's recollection, was a very spiritual person with a big heart and good perception. Cairne also noted that Baine took after her in that regard. After dying from an incurable illness, her soul remained on Azeroth to watch over Cairne and Baine. She briefly met with Cairne on his passing, and he, too, decided to stay, awaiting Baine with Tamaala.

Taming the Wild is an account-wide Pet Battles achievement earned by defeating a master-level pet tamers on the Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Outland, Northrend, or Pandaria continents.

During the Legion Invasions, the ancient, apparently regrown and much bigger, wandered around Azshara and attacked the invading demons, including bosses.

They are allies of the demigod Aviana and protectors of the winged creatures of the Broken Isles. To gain access to this faction, the player must have completed at least one of the four falcosaur quest lines. The player must travel to the Sylvan Falls and speak to Aviana while mounted on one of the falcosaur mounts (Predatory Bloodgazer, Brilliant Direbeak, Viridian Sharptalon or Snowfeather Hunter), which will cause her to accuse the adventurer of murdering her children, ignoring their excuse of trying to control their population as she is a guardian of nature, who knows better about such

Taloc is a titan construct and the first boss of Uldir. It is initially seen atop the Heart of Darkness in Nazmir, being corrupted by blood. The Gob Squad tried to destroy it with their A.M.O.D., but the operation couldn't be succeeded until Grand Ma'da Ateena was killed and the blood shield dispelled. Taloc then fell after the Heart of Darkness roof collapsed.
Tallelah Clearpath is a Highmountain tauren located in Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound.

__NOTOC__ Tamed Krolusks are krolusks mainly located around the Feeding Pits in Vol'dun, usually tended to by Faithless Beastlords or Faithless Deadeyes. They are normally but turn and can be mounted after being damage to 50% health. While controlling a Tamed Krolusk, the player can command it to use the Charge ability, but doing so will knock the player off the mount and cause the krolusk to run off and despawn. One Tamed Krolusk serves as the mount of Sandscout Vesarik in Vol'dun's northwestern dunes and has the title.

The Talonbranch are a pack of worgen who make their home within the area of Talonbranch Glade. They hold loyalty to Gilneas, as evidenced by the kingdom's banners that are strewn throughout the Glade, but there are some who have been around since Velinde Starsong first used the Scythe of Elune, meaning some of them are night elves. They are led by Denmother Ulrica. The pack, having taken over the Glade area (a tree akin to Tal'doren) for the most part, defends it from the Bilgewater Cartel goblin lumber operations in Felwood. Under instruction from Denmother Ulrica and with aid from their night elven allies, the pack and an adventurer are ultimately successful in destroying the operations th
Talons of Grim Revelations drops from Prophet Skitra in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Tamed Owls are owls that accompany Duskwatch Observers in Suramar City.
__NOTOC__ Tamesis is a kyrian sitting in Bastion. Next to her are a Cloudrift Runner, River Terrapin, and Fluttering Glimmerfly. She and Zosime are friends.
__NOTOC__ Talonguard Vrykiss is a black drakonid located in Island Expeditions.
Talon Rend is a pet ability available exclusively to the bird of prey family of hunter pets.
Talisman of the Lost Blue Flight is a quest reward from Runas the Shamed (quest).
Tamed Skitterfly is sold by Granpap Whiskers at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores for after reaching 25 Renown with the Dragonscale Expedition.
Talon Smoht is a bronze drakonid flight master located at Gelikyr Post in Thaldraszus.
Talon's Watch is a remote island with a tower and a Dragon Glyph on it, southwest of the mainland of Forbidden Reach.

Talon Stand is a hill located directly in the middle of Wyrmscar Island northeast of Bloodmyst Isle. It is populated by many dragon whelps. Here, the undead black dragon Razormaw can be brought down to earth, where he can be defeated.
Tarn is a tauren located in the Thunder Bluff Armorers building on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
Tand is a tauren bag vendor located in the Cloudweaver's Baskets shop on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.

Tarban Hearthgrain is a tauren cooking and bread vendor located outside a hut just east of the Crossroads at the foot of a mountain, in the Northern Barrens. During the Legion Invasions, he was cowering in fear behind Guard Taruc.
__NOTOC__ Tannaria is a blood elf rogue trainer located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. According to Silvermoon Guardians, she is well skilled in remaining out of sight.

Taretha's Gift is the final quest in a Horde quest chain in Hillsbrad Foothills and Alterac Mountains. It involves returning a momento of Taretha Foxton, Thrall's childhood friend, to the possession of the orcs. You must have completed Lord Aliden Perenolde in order to get this quest.
The Tarantula Silk Sash drops from Chatter in Redridge Mountains. It was later reintroduced with Salvage Crates but later removed again.

Tapper Swindlekeg was a goblin in charge of the Brewfest event outside of Orgrimmar. He would explain anything you needed to know about the event. He was later removed and replaced with La'gar Brewshout as the Horde organizer. In the expansion; Tapper Swindlekeg appears once more alongside Ipfelkofer Ironkeg within the Zskera Vaults. There he offers the quest A Brew for the Ages, where the two of them search for new brew recipes to bring to Brewfest, showing that Swindlekeg is still involved in Brewfest in some capacity.

Tarm was a tauren in service of Helka Grimtotem. He was asked to accompany Valeera Sanguinar on the back of Bristlefur. While flying on the wyvern above the trees of Feralas she distracted and kicked him out of the wyvern. Valeera commented that tomorrow he will not have a job for his failure. It is unknown whether he shares Grimtotem name as it was not mentioned.
Tarlhir is a blood elf Scryers warrior trainer located at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

Target Acquisition Devices are gnomish copters found wandering around the Train Depot of Gnomeregan. They pick up Crazed Leper Gnomes and carry them off, presumably to be decontaminated. However, all they actually do is fly around a bit. The S.A.F.E. Operatives will shoot at the gnome in tow; the Target Acquisition Device despawns shortly after the mob's death.

Tarna Brightfeather was an elite Twin Peaks battlemaster located on the Vault of Lights in the draenei city of the Exodar during the Call to Arms: Twin Peaks. She was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Twin Peaks).

__NOTOC__ Tarelvir is a Highborne night elf mage trainer located near the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. He is seen talking to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker. He also directs mages to Maginor Dumas for questing. Tarelvir becomes part of the reformed Tirisgarde during the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth. He can be found in the Hall of the Guardian in Dalaran. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved by Alliance adventurers.
Tan My Hide is a monthly quest that can be completed during Darkmoon Faire. You must have 75 skinning skill to complete.

__NOTOC__ Tana Lentner is a worgen engineering trainer located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. She's most likely related to fellow engineering supplies vendor Hugo Lentner. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was seemingly evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.

:"Discipline: It is the only way." Taran Zhu is the Lord of the Shado-Pan, a skilled order of pandaren monks and warriors dedicated to protect the balance of Pandaria from all threats coming from within or without the continent. He held a great mistrust of any race outside the pandaren and looked at the Alliance-Horde war as a pointless "race war" that did not need to involve his homeland. His hatred would ironically draw the Sha of Hatred to him, eventually being freed by the very adventurers he believed were the corrupt ones. From there he would join the Horde and Alliance in the campaigns against the Sha, the Thunder King, and Garrosh Hellscream. His wary nature serves as foil to the ever
Tang Ironhoe is a representative of the Tillers sent to the Shrine of Seven Stars to recruit Alliance. He can be found on the lower level of the Summer Terrace.
Tanner Pang is a pandaren located in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Tan Strongpole is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Tar'thog Bridge is an Iron Horde bridge between the Bleeding Altar and Kargathar Proving Grounds. It is destroyed by Khadgar after crossing it.

Tanda Freeseeker is a tauren sleeping next to Bax Freeseeker in a hut just east of the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. Marcus the paladin can be found sleeping next to them, though upon approach he wakes up and walks out of the hut, saying The encounter between Tanda, Marcus and Bax is detailed in A Steamy Romance Novel: Got Milk?.
Tannon the Spiritbinder is a night elf located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.

Tangled Cleft is a mountainous area adjacent to Shala'nir, Darkheart Thicket, and the Dreamgrove. Shar'thos occasionally returns to roost here, and Shalas'aman can sometimes be found hiding in the cleft. During Fish Frenzy, the cave in the Gloaming Reef goes by this name. The Brineblood Hydra can be found here.

Taraafash is an eredar brute located in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun. He blocks the road of High Exarch Turalyon and the adventurer during Gathering Light. He is however swiftly dealt with by Captain Fareeya.
The Target Designator can be used to mark Immortal Squadron Fighters at the Terminus in the Antoran Wastes. Once marked, the fighters will be taken out by the Vindicaar.
Targuz is a doomguard located in Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.
Tarn Riverhorn is a tauren spirit that can be summoned by Water Totem Figurine on Akule Riverhorn's canoe at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Taranyr Gravesorrow is a Forsaken that briefly appeared in the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale during the War of the Thorns.
__NOTOC__ Tanzanite Shatterers are earth elementals located in Suramar.
Tarnished Medallion is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tarnished Sentinel Medallion drops from the Sisters of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.

Tarnished Soul is a debuff that is applied to characters who have died with the Soul of Iron buff. The debuff can be removed by talking with Watcher Fero in the Hall of Explorers of Ironforge or Watcher Morta in the Apothecarium of Undercity. The debuff reduces all stats by 1%.

The Tangled Dreamweaver is the mount obtained from purchasing 's Collector's Edition, Epic Edition or Heroic Edition. Obtaining this mount rewards the Heroic Edition: Tangled Dreamweaver feat of strength.

Tarasek are dragonkin native to the Dragon Isles. They are highly adaptive, peerless hunters able to channel elemental energies. Neltharion considered them little more than fodder and targets for the training of the dracthyr. But they are cunning hunters, and deadly when encountered in packs. Over ten thousand years ago, the Dragon Aspects uplifted the tarasek into the first drakonid. Recently, they have been gaining elemental power from the Primalists, becoming even more dangerous. In Thaldraszus, tarasek use a poisonous sap on their spears.

__NOTOC__ Taravos is a draenei located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken. He traveled to the Dragon Isles with Tinsy Gleamsprocket where they both ended up in a proto-dragon trap. Zorza freed them and lead them to the safety of the city.
Taresh is a green dragonspawn located in the Fields of Ferocity in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Together with Sherath, they are known as Twin Dreamers.

The tauren (shu'halo in their native language of Taur-ahe and sometimes pluralized as taurens) are a race of large, bovine humanoids who dwell on the great plains of Central Kalimdor. For countless generations, they were constantly harassed by the violent centaur, who forced the tauren into a nomadic lifestyle in the harsh Barrens. However, during the Third War and the Horde's invasion of Kalimdor, the tauren and the invading Horde became allies, and the Horde aided the tauren in driving off the centaur from the sacred lands of Mulgore. High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof established the capital city of Thunder Bluff, and to this day the tauren remain one of the most stalwart allies of the Horde
Tawny Grisette is a wandering Forsaken fungus and drink vendor located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. After the Forsaken reclaimed the Ruins of Lordaeron, she moved there.
Taskmaster Whipfang is a rare gnoll found in Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Taronn Redfeather is a tauren quest giver located at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood. Taronn is now found in the Dreamgrove, where he teaches baby wildkin while in Moonkin Form.

The tauren chieftains are elder tauren warriors that lead their tribes in daily life as well as in battle. Ceremoniously decked with the ancient totems of their tribes, chiefs uphold the honor and simplicity of tauren culture. When roused by battle, the gigantic chiefs employ enormous warblades which are capable of tearing through solid trees with one mighty swipe. The chiefs are fascinated by the orcs, especially their young leader, Thrall. The chiefs see an opportunity to help the orcs return to their traditional roots by providing a strong example of honor and courage through all tauren warriors. According to Marshal Troteman, the Horde sent tauren chieftains to attack Lion's Landing forc

Taskmaster Varkule Dragonbreath is a fel orc quest giver located at the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. He is to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing. Varkule started his career as a miner.
The Tawny Wind Rider can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Hellfire Peninsula * in Shadowmoon Valley * in Orgrimmar * in Dalaran * in Borean Tundra
Tazan's Satchel drops from Tazan in the Barrens. It is later provided as an objective for The Shattered Hand (2).

This article is a list of tauren organizations. Tauren seem to be grouped into "tribes" rather than "clans" but smaller families do also seeem to exist. Main tribes: * Bloodhoof – The chieftain's own tribe. * Cliffwalker – A tribe living at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains. * Cloudsong – They picked up the role of spiritual leaders of the tauren shamans after the Skychaser tribe was nearly wiped out. * Darkmane – A tribe known for being a jack of all trades. * Dawnchaser – A tribe of tauren living in Krasarang Wilds. * Dawnstrider – The Dawnstrider tribe are experienced enchanters and skilled shamans. * Eagletalon – This tribe hunts the harpi

__NOTOC__ Taruk is a tauren member of the Northsea Freebooters located at Scalawag Point in the Howling Fjord. He is a really good gambler, as "Silvermoon" Harry, Jack Adams, and Black Conrad owe him money.

Taunka'le Village is a taunka village found just southeast of the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra. The taunka used the steam from the hot springs to help prepare hides for leatherworking. During the war against the Lich King, Chieftain Wintergale asked for the help of Horde adventurers in evacuating the village, as he feared the Scourge would attack them soon. A fear that turned out to be real, the village now being in ruins and overrun by the undead from the Temple City of En'kilah.

When roused by battle, the gigantic tauren chieftains employ enormous halberds that are capable of tearing through solid trees with one mighty swipe. The weapons are not limited only to chieftains as Kaw the Mammoth Destroyer had one.

The tauren starting experience takes place on Red Cloud Mesa, in southern Mulgore. Players are immediately thrust into battle against the quilboar who are mere days away from taking Camp Narache. Working with Grull Hawkwind and Adana Thunderhorn, players slay quilboar, rescue tauren captives, return stolen weapons and prevent the quilboar from using a special weapon, the battleboars, among other things. On the way, players complete their Rite of Strength by slaying quilboar, their Rite of Courage by recovering stolen rifles, and their Rite of Honor by slaying Chief Squealer Thornmantle. The Red Cloud Mesa ends with the quest Rite of the Winds which transports players to Bloodhoof Village.

Tau Be is a pandaren residing in Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest. Due to the chaos caused by the battle between the Alliance of Thunder Hold and the Horde of the Hellscream's Fist, his farm was destroyed.

Tattered Note is a piece of parchment at the base of a cave in blocking the mouth of the Mysterious Den in the Red Stone Run, on the eastern side of the Timeless Isle. This suggests to find one of the Timeless Legends on the isle, and use the provided bonus ability on the Cave-In. Should players somehow find themselves locked inside the mysterious den, there is a Rock-breaking Hammer on the inside that can be used to break the cave-in as well. Either method of breaking the cave-in will immediately summon Spelurk, a rare mistlurker.
A Tattered Scroll is an Inscription skill-up item. Repairing it will yield either a Hidden Text Scroll or an Empowered Scroll.
Tattered Pamphlet is given by Doomsayers in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City as a precursor of the Legion Invasion‎.
Taskmaster Filthwhisker is a kobold located in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Taskmaster Skraggletail is a kobold located in Highmountain.
Taste of Blood is a hidden ability of The Dreadblades that triggers off humanoid kill, low or high level, and stacks to 10 for a max of +20% movement speed. Does not stack with sprint.
Tattered Silkwings are moths located in the Twilight Vineyards in Suramar City.

The Tauren Outcasts were a small group of white tauren spirit walkers dwelling in a small camp in Mulgore. They were led by Bovan Windtotem. During the Invasion of Durotar, they were approached by Rexxar and his group who asked Bovan to help him locate Baine Bloodhoof. Using his mystical powers, Bovan located Khiragg's centaur encampment and the imprisoned Baine. The tauren then joined Rexxar, fought their way to the encampment, resurrecting deceased tauren warriors along the way. They successfully rescued Baine. Their status afterwards is unknown.
Taylor Quickshift is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island. He can be found chatting with Resser Quickshift about the adventurers.
Taunka Spirit Guides are the Horde Spirit Guides for Wintergrasp. They can be found at each cemetery, and can teleport you to controlled areas.
Tastefully Scented Grease is looted from Mechanized Chests and Mechanized Supply Chests on Mechagon Island.
Tarren Mill Peasant Specimens are humans located outside the Old Hillsbrad Foothills in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.
Tattered Teachings is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tasteful Eyeglasses are cosmetic eyeglasses in the head slot sold for by Finn in outside the Barber Shop in the Trade District of Stormwind City or Ca'nees in the Barber Shop of Orgrimmar.
Taurson's Champion Belt is looted from Taurson's Prize in Highmountain.

Tattered Collar of the Succubus was a consumable item obtained by speaking with Laphandrus Voidheart in Stormwind City or Kazak Darkscream in Orgrimmar. When used, it replaces the warlock's Summon Sayaad spell with Summon Succubus. Its counterpart is Barbed Collar of the Incubus.

Tattered Collar of the Incubus was a consumable item obtained by speaking with Laphandrus Voidheart in Stormwind City or Kazak Darkscream in Orgrimmar. When used, it replaces the warlock's Summon Sayaad spell with Summon Incubus. Its counterpart is Barbed Collar of the Succubus.
Tazenrath's Torn Wing is the remains of the Runic Wing, after its magic has run dry.
Tartek may refer to: *Warlord Tartek, a wolvar in Sholazar Basin. *Tartek the Enraged, one of the most powerful abominations the Scourge has ever created.

__NOTOC__ Tel'Athir is a night elf alchemist located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. He is an alchemist-in-training, presumably under the tutelage of the nearby alchemy trainer Lilyssia Nightbreeze. He can be found inside the alchemy shop Alchemy Needs, located in the far eastern section of the Mage Quarter.
Teg Dawnstrider is a tauren artisan enchanting trainer located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
Teardrop Tourmaline could be purchased for from: * in Terokkar Forest * in Hellfire Peninsula * in Shattrath City * in Netherstorm * in Hellfire Peninsula
